scope: Round 5: isolate a stale-vehicle-readiness false rejection in M5 distance-descent filtering. Preserve search policy, budget, arc-cache-disabled default and full decoder/audit. Development covers all 30 observed 50-customer 5-2 and 100-customer 5-3 jobs. Held-out uses scenario02 of 5-2 at nested 50/100 sizes; these scenarios were not used for this optimization selection, and are not new independent mother instances. B2/B3, full/tight pools, 5s and additional 15s for 100-customer B3; 100000 iteration cap. Descriptive engineering comparison.
selection_rule: Demonstrate a fully audited feasible distance improvement rejected solely by stale previous-trip completion times. Use all 30 development jobs to compare any candidates; preserve failed experiments. Freeze one complete candidate before examining held-out distance quality. Final uses all 60 registered jobs, with no per-job best-of selection. Default adoption requires complete audited feasibility, improved mean distance and no increase in average seed CV; otherwise retain as an optional experimental change or withdraw.
